title: Definition
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Other Public Assistance > Definition
text:
(a) Definition 
Public Assistance refers to income received from government assistance 
programs.

title: Required Documentation
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Other Public Assistance > Required Documentation
text:
(b) Required Documentation 
Lenders must verify and document the income received from the government 
agency and that the income is reasonably likely to continue for three years.

title: Calculation of Effective Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Other Public Assistance > Calculation of Effective Income
text:
Calculation of Effective Income 
The Lender must use the current rate of Public Assistance received to 
calculate Effective Income.

title: Automobile Allowance
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Automobile Allowance
text: (7) Automobile Allowance

title: Definition
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Automobile Allowance > Definition
text:
(a) Definition 
Automobile Allowance refers to the funds provided by the Borrower’s 
employer for automobile related expenses.

title: Required Documentation
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Automobile Allowance > Required Documentation
text:
(b) Required Documentation 
The Lender must verify and document the Automobile Allowance received 
from the employer for the previous two years. 
The Lender must also obtain IRS Form 2106, Employee Business Expenses, 
for the previous two years.

title: Calculation of Effective Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Automobile Allowance > Calculation of Effective Income
text:
(c) Calculation of Effective Income 
The Lender must determine the portion of the allowance that can be 
considered Effective Income. 
The Lender must subtract automobile expenses as shown on IRS Form 2106 
from the Automobile Allowance before calculating Effective Income based on 
the current amount of the allowance received. 
If the Borrower uses the standard per-mile rate in calculating automobile 
expenses, as opposed to the actual cost method, the portion that the IRS 
considers depreciation may be added back to income. Expenses that must be 
treated as recurring debt include: 
• the Borrower’s monthly car payment; and 
• any loss resulting from the calculation of the difference between the 
actual expenditures and the expense account allowance. 
Automobile Allowance refers to the amount of the Automobile Allowance that 
exceeds the Borrower’s actual automobile expenditures.

title: Retirement Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income
text:
(8) Retirement Income 
Retirement Income refers to income received from Pensions, 401(k) distributions, 
and Social Security.

title: Social Security Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Social Security Income
text: (a) Social Security Income

title: Definition
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Social Security Income > Definition
text:
(i) Definition 
Social Security Income or Supplemental Security Income (SSI) refers to 
income received from the SSA other than disability income.

title: Required Documentation
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Social Security Income > Required Documentation
text:
(ii) Required Documentation 
The Lender must verify and document the Borrower’s receipt of income 
from the SSA and that it is likely to continue for at least a three-year 
period from the date of case number assignment. 
For SSI, the Lender must obtain any one of the following documents: 
• Tax Returns (minimum one year); 
• the most recent bank statement evidencing receipt of income from 
the SSA; 
• a Proof of Income Letter, also known as a “Budget Letter” or 
“Benefits Letter” that evidences income from the SSA; or 
• a copy of the Borrower’s form SSA-1099/1042S. 
In addition to verification of income, the Lender must document the 
continuance of this income by obtaining from the Borrower (1) a copy of 
the last Notice of Award letter which states the SSA’s determination on the 
Borrower’s eligibility for SSA income, or (2) an equivalent document that 
establishes award benefits to the Borrower (equivalent document). If any 
income from the SSA is due to expire within three years from the date of 
case number assignment, that income may not be used for qualifying. 
If the Notice of Award or equivalent document does not have a defined 
expiration date, the Lender must consider the income effective and 
reasonably likely to continue. The Lender should not request additional 
documentation from the Borrower to demonstrate continuance of SSA 
income. 
If the Notice of Award letter or equivalent document specifies a future 
start date for receipt of income, this income may only be considered 
effective on the specified start date.

title: Calculation of Effective Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Social Security Income > Calculation of Effective Income
text:
(iii)Calculation of Effective Income 
The Lender must use the current amount of Social Security Income 
received to calculate Effective Income.

title: Pension
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Pension
text: (b) Pension

title: Definition
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Pension > Definition
text:
(i) Definition 
Pension refers to income received from the Borrower’s former 
employer(s).

title: Required Documentation
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Pension > Required Documentation
text:
(ii) Required Documentation 
The Lender must verify and document the Borrower’s receipt of periodic 
payments from the Borrower’s Pension and that the payments are likely to 
continue for at least three years. 
The Lender must obtain any one of the following documents: 
• Tax Returns (minimum one year); 
• the most recent bank statement evidencing receipt of income from 
the former employer; or 
• a copy of the Borrower’s pension/retirement letter from the former 
employer.

title: Calculation of Effective Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Pension > Calculation of Effective Income
text:
(iii)Calculation of Effective Income 
The Lender must use the current amount of Pension income received to 
calculate Effective Income.

title: Individual Retirement Account and 401(k)
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Individual Retirement Account and 401(k)
text: (c) Individual Retirement Account and 401(k)

title: Definition
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Individual Retirement Account and 401(k) > Definition
text:
(i) Definition 
Individual Retirement Account (IRA)/401(k) Income refers to income 
received from an IRA.

title: Required Documentation
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Individual Retirement Account and 401(k) > Required Documentation
text:
(ii) Required Documentation 
The Lender must verify and document the Borrower’s receipt of recurring 
IRA/401(k) Income and that it is reasonably likely to continue for three 
years. 
The Lender must obtain the most recent IRA/401(k) statement and any 
one of the following documents: 
• Tax Returns; or 
• the most recent bank statement evidencing receipt of income.

title: Calculation of Effective Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Retirement Income > Individual Retirement Account and 401(k) > Calculation of Effective Income
text:
(iii)Calculation of Effective Income 
For Borrowers with IRA/401(k) Income that has been and will be 
consistently received, the Lender must use the current amount of IRA
Income received to calculate Effective Income. For Borrowers with 
fluctuating IRA/401(k) Income, the Lender must use the average of the 
IRA/401(k) Income received over the previous two years to calculate 
Effective Income. If IRA/401(k) Income has been received for less than 
two years, the Lender must use the average over the time of receipt.

title: Rental Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income
text: (9) Rental Income

title: Definition
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Definition
text:
(a) Definition 
Rental Income refers to income received or to be received from the subject 
Property or other real estate holdings.

title: Rental Income from Other Real Estate Holdings
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Rental Income from Other Real Estate Holdings
text: (b) Rental Income from Other Real Estate Holdings

title: Standard
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Rental Income from Other Real Estate Holdings > Standard
text:
(i) Standard 
Rental Income from other real estate holdings may be considered Effective 
Income if the documentation requirements listed below are met. If Rental 
Income is being derived from the Property being vacated by the Borrower, 
the Borrower must be relocating to an area more than 100 miles from the 
Borrower’s current Principal Residence.

title: Required Documentation
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Rental Income from Other Real Estate Holdings > Required Documentation
text:
(ii) Required Documentation 
The Lender must obtain the Borrower’s last two years’ Tax Returns with 
Schedule E.

title: Calculation of Effective Net Rental Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Rental Income from Other Real Estate Holdings > Calculation of Effective Net Rental Income
text:
(iii)Calculation of Effective Net Rental Income 
The Lender must calculate the net Rental Income by averaging the amount 
shown on Schedule E, provided the Borrower continues to own all 
Properties included on Schedule E. 
Depreciation, mortgage interest, taxes, insurance, and any HOA dues 
shown on Schedule E may be added back to the net income or loss. 
If the Property has been owned for less than two years, the Lender must 
annualize the Rental Income for the length of time the Property has been 
owned. 
For Properties with less than two years of Rental Income history, the 
Lender must document the date of acquisition by providing the deed, 
Settlement Statement or similar legal document. 
Positive net Rental Income must be added to the Borrower’s Effective 
Income. Negative net Rental Income must be included as a debt/liability.

title: Boarders of the Subject Property
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Boarders of the Subject Property
text: (c) Boarders of the Subject Property

title: Definition
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Boarders of the Subject Property > Definition
text:
(i) Definition 
Boarder refers to an individual renting space inside the Borrower’s 
Dwelling Unit.

title: Standard
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Boarders of the Subject Property > Standard
text:
(ii) Standard 
Rental Income from Boarders is only acceptable if the Borrower has a 
two-year history of receiving income from Boarders that is shown on the 
Tax Return and the Borrower is currently receiving boarder income.

title: Required Documentation
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Boarders of the Subject Property > Required Documentation
text:
(iii)Required Documentation 
The Lender must obtain two years of the Borrower’s Tax Returns 
evidencing income from Boarders and the current lease. 
For purchase transactions, the Lender must obtain a copy of the executed 
written agreement documenting their intent to continue boarding with the 
Borrower.

title: Calculation of Effective Income
path: ORIGINATION THROUGH POST-CLOSING/ENDORSEMENT > Title I Insured Programs > Manufactured Home Loan Program > Underwriting the Borrower > Income Requirements > Other Sources of Effective Income > Rental Income > Boarders of the Subject Property > Calculation of Effective Income
text:
(iv) Calculation of Effective Income 
The Lender must calculate the Effective Income by using the lesser of the 
two-year average or the current lease.
